item.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
item.description: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Hong Kong pushes to bring crypto custodians, advisers under licensing rules
item.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator says the proposal would strengthen investor protections, with the bill set for its first reading in the Legislative Council on Dec. 2.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Wrapped Monero token crashes 99.8% amid suspected $13.5M exploit
item.description: Bitquery traced $13.5 million in suspicious sales of the wrapped Monero token, as its operator blamed a security breach and promised to reimburse affected traders.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
item.description: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Bitcoin falls below $60K for first time since July amid broader market selloff
item.description: Bitcoin fell nearly 6% as US stocks declined, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 2% and Anthropic shares losing almost 10%.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US Senate advances prediction market restrictions with DEATH BETS Act
item.description: The Senate-approved bill would ban prediction market contracts tied to war, assassination and death amid concerns over potential insider trading on military events.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin price drops to $60K as Anthropic drops to $87 in tech sell-off
item.description: Bitcoin price strength felt pressure from falling US equities as traders reassessed AI prospects after Anthropic’s IPO.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
item.description: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Yohan Yun

item.title: Lagarde warns Europe could miss chance to unify tokenized markets
item.description: The ECB president said Europe’s market for tokenized securities could split into platforms that cannot settle trades with one another.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Binance hacker moves nearly $600M in ETH, routes funds through THORChain, Chainflip
item.description: OnChain Lens tracked nearly $600 million in ETH transfers over two days as the Binance hackers moved the stolen funds through fresh wallets and cross-chain protocols to obscure their trail.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: VanEck to end Gemini ETF custody deals, keeps Coinbase
item.description: VanEck plans to end Gemini’s custody agreements for three crypto ETFs in February 2027, while Coinbase will continue serving as a custodian for the funds.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Bitcoin nears repeat of chart pattern that preceded 2023’s $25K retest
item.description: Bitcoin’s 21-day moving average fell below its 200-day average, and analyst Keith Alan expects a second bearish crossover by Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: BlackRock’s IBIT loses record $541M amid Anthropic market debut
item.description: BlackRock’s IBIT posted its largest daily outflow on record, taking three-session outflows near $900 million as BTC dipped amid a broader market selloff.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: SEC charges 8 firms over fake crypto platforms tied to $37M fraud
item.description: The SEC says the operators showed investors fake certificates and pointed them to filings on the agency’s website as proof of regulatory approval.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Anthropic’s $81B IPO draws half the net retail buying of SpaceX’s
item.description: Retail investors traded $772 million in Anthropic shares on Thursday, the most Vanda Research has recorded for a market debut since 2012.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Institutions pile back into US Bitcoin ETFs in Q3 after selling streak
item.description: Asset managers added the equivalent of 49,229 Bitcoin to their US Bitcoin ETF holdings in the third quarter, reversing three quarters of net selling.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Ledger CTO Charles Guillemet to leave after nine years at company
item.description: Guillemet helped establish Ledger’s Donjon security lab and says his departure has been planned for months.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Binance’s $6.5B freeze order, Hong Kong ‘suspicious’ of HYPE: Asia Express
item.description: Binance obtains court orders freezing assets stolen in October’s hack. Hong Kong warns citizens about Hyperliquid, and Thai police arrest four foreigners linked to a crypto scam.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
item.description: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Hyperliquid Anthropic futures priced within 1% of Nasdaq opening price
item.description: Hyperliquid traders priced Anthropic futures within 1% of the stock’s Nasdaq opening price, as trading surged ahead of the AI company’s IPO.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Trump’s SEC nominee Johnson backs formal rulemaking for tokenized stock trading
item.description: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
item.description: Ethereum developers are weighing changes to gas pricing proposals that could disrupt existing smart contracts, after contacting at least 50 affected companies.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms
item.description: A treasury company can have years of dividends covered and still struggle to sell new shares on terms that make another Bitcoin purchase worthwhile.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Adrian Zmudzinski

item.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100
item.description: Bitcoin dropped toward a third retest of $62,000 as Anthropic debuted on the Nasdaq, hitting highs of $115 per share before dropping below $100.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Anthropic shares open at $111.50, 34.3% above $83 IPO price
item.description: The Claude chatbot maker began trading under the ticker ANT, with the company’s valuation at around $2 trillion at the opening price.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Bryan O'Shea

item.title: Ethereum’s new DeFi security tool raises questions over censorship
item.description: Phylax’s system lets decentralized protocols block potentially harmful transactions, but raises questions about potential censorship and Ethereum’s concentrated builder market.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of ‘suspicious’ crypto platforms
item.description: Hong Kong’s securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted its trading services to investors in the city.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: GTA VI publisher racks up nearly 3x Nvidia’s tokenized stock volume
item.description: Tokenized Take-Two shares drew $249.5 million in DEX volume Wednesday, nearly three times the $88.1 million for tokenized Nvidia shares.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Sweden’s H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
item.description: Shareholders will vote Dec. 7 on whether H100 can buy back up to 10% of its shares, potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
